review_scope: Fixed primary, all four source differences, auxiliary AUC and all scope J/Q tables checked against saved independent analysis
Both prespecified recombination orientations and all 199 aggregate reference entries retained; reference means/tails independently arithmetically verified
Read report, generation template and recorded execution/metric audit coverage; no new model or gradient replay
All report local links exist; image visual QA was not repeated

findings.interpretation: High familiar-support success does not yield a stable target-path-count advantage on the common untrained pairs.
Truth-conditioned donor construction can use partial fragment correspondences in these learned protocols; this does not establish autonomous composition or its learning cause.

limitations: Four inherited development sources; panels, communication directions, photo/mask rows and relabelings do not increase independent n.
P6 is a matching and cannot by itself identify independent expression of both resource positions; a support-specific no-message optimum is 1/6.
Graph cycles, overlap coverage and target path counts covary, so a single isolated path mechanism is not identified.
Full-code relabeling is post-training and preserves full-message behavior; it does not control architectural slot biases or constitute randomized training.
Artificial recombination uses true target attributes to choose donors and must not be called naturally generated messages; neither orientation was selected by max.
The 0.005 tail fraction is finite reference resolution, not a four-source significance test.
Only endpoint forward replay and selected update fixtures/traces were independently checked; no full Adam training replay.
Small development image pool, one test water photo, and prior private exposure to all30 layouts limit novelty and extrapolation.
corrections_in_final_report: Added explicit fragment interpretation, architecture/relabeling limits and source heterogeneity.
Message display describes its fixed first-source/first-photo rule without claiming inclusion in the runner frozen plan.
Distinguishes terminal elapsed209.635seconds from training-loop recorded209.086seconds and discloses development audit path repair.
next_step: Design a common evaluation support with at least two alternatives per resource position and a corresponding single-resource-expression bound. This is not an executed or frozen next training matrix.
